description: This file defines an abstract base class 'TestClusterPerTest' for managing Orleans test clusters within a testing framework. It includes setup and teardown logic, precondition checks, and configuration hooks for derived test classes.

classes.name: TestClusterPerTest
classes.description: An abstract base class for managing Orleans test clusters in unit tests, providing setup, teardown, and configuration hooks.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes and deploys the test cluster asynchronously, setting up logging.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the test cluster, stopping silos and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: EnsurePreconditionsMet
methods.description: Checks if preconditions for the test are met, throwing stored exceptions if not.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Virtual method for subclasses to implement precondition checks.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Virtual method for subclasses to customize test cluster configuration.
